intent: the app's model row stops being a list compiled into the client. A box whose harness can enumerate its models reports them over a NEW box->harness notification (notifications/hotline/harness_catalog) and the box mirrors them to devices on a NEW transient frame agent_catalog. Two tiers, and they are different sets on purpose: the ROWS are the operator's filtered/cycling scope for this box (pi's --models selection — literally the set Ctrl+P walks), while the free-text escape reaches the FULL model registry and is validated by the harness with a real key check. The scope is box-owned: `hotline up` resolves HOTLINE_PI_MODELS (or an explicit `-- --models` passthrough, which wins) into pi's --models flag AND re-exports the effective value into the harness env, because an extension cannot read pi's resolved cycling list — AgentSession.scopedModels is not on the ExtensionContext/ExtensionAPI surface — so the box is the only place all three surfaces (launch line, Ctrl+P, app) can be made to agree. agent_catalog is PUSHED once per device on subscribe and re-broadcast on change, never stapled onto welcome or agent_state: those carry the ONE live model and restamp on every model/effort change, and a model list riding them would re-send the whole catalog several times per apply. A box that sends no catalog (every binary predating this amendment, and any harness that has not implemented it) leaves the app on its curated fallback list — absence is the compatibility path, there is no negotiation and no version flag.

assertions.statement: agent_catalog is a transient content frame in the agent_state/typing family: seq'd, never durable, never acked, never replayed. It is sent to a single device on subscribe (after drain, alongside the agent_state snapshot) and broadcast to all active devices when the catalog changes. A box holding no catalog sends NOTHING on subscribe — never an empty frame, because an empty catalog claims 'this box has a menu and it is empty' while absence correctly means 'this box has no menu, keep your fallback'.

each catalog entry carries id (the CANONICAL id the app sends back in a set_sdk_config and the same form the harness restamps as the live identity, so a selected row shows as selected — 'provider/id' on pi), an optional short display label, and available (whether the box holds a usable credential for it). available is always serialized: an omitted false would be indistinguishable from a frame that never carried the field. The frame additionally carries harness, source (models|settings|available — which precedence branch produced the list), and truncated when the list was cut at the cap.

the rows are the operator's FILTERED scope, reconstructed through pi's own code rather than guessed: the box exports the effective --models patterns as HOTLINE_PI_MODELS, and the harness resolves them with pi's exported resolveModelScopeWithDiagnostics against the live ModelRegistry — the same function and the same registry pi's main.js uses to build AgentSession.scopedModels. Precedence mirrors pi exactly: the --models scope, else pi's own enabledModels setting, else every model with auth configured (which is what cycleModel falls back to when nothing is scoped). A scope that matches NOTHING reports the available set, not an empty list, because pi's cycleModel ignores an empty scope the same way.

passthrough-wins is preserved and observable: `hotline up -- --models <patterns>` suppresses the HOTLINE_PI_MODELS knob on the launch line (piModelArgs drops a knob flag the passthrough already carries), and the box therefore re-exports the PASSTHROUGH value, never the inert knob. Otherwise the app would advertise a list Ctrl+P does not cycle.

the free-text escape is a strictly wider tier than the rows and is validated by the HARNESS, not the catalog: the id is resolved against the FULL registry (resolveCliModel -> modelRegistry.getAll(), which deliberately includes models without pre-configured auth) and then key-checked by ExtensionAPI.setModel. A model absent from the catalog but present in the registry WITH a credential applies normally and answers ok+hot. Nothing resolves -> unknown_model. It resolves but the box holds no credential for its provider -> no_api_key, refused before the live session is touched — never silently applied, and never collapsed into unknown_model, because the two have different fixes (a typo vs a login).

compatibility is by absence in both directions. Old box + new app: no agent_catalog ever arrives and the app renders its curated list, unchanged. New box + old app: the unknown agent_catalog t is dropped by the old parser exactly like any other unrecognized transient, and the curated list is what it renders. A harness that reports an empty catalog CLEARS the box's catalog and the app falls back — that is how a re-scoped box tells the app to stop showing a list that no longer exists.
